letter:
Dear Anika Patel,

Thank you for sending the roof plan we asked for on 10 Sep 2026. Your application MIA-2026-1163 for an accessory dwelling unit and rooftop solar at 960 Tamarind Street now needs one more item before we can continue. We have checked the whole file so that this is our last request:

1. A current contractor licence (Plan review checklist item 2). The licence on your application, EC13006666 for Keystone Electric and Solar LLC, expired on 31 Aug 2026. The rules require a licence that is valid on the date the application is filed. Keystone can send us proof of renewal from the Florida licensing board, or you can name another licensed contractor for the work.

Everything else in your application meets the rules, including the panel capacity for both projects.

Please reply by 5 Oct 2026 through the applicant portal or by email to permits@example.com. Call (305) 555-0100 if you have questions.

Building Department, City of Miami
